verdict.rationale: Hands-on probes confirm that a keyless GET of https://askjo.ai/openapi.json returns a real OpenAPI 3.1.0 spec (FastAPI, about 405 paths including /v1/auth, /v1/users and /v1/apple-messages), with Swagger UI served at /docs. That meets the literal story of downloading a machine-readable API spec. However, it appears to be the internal app/bridge backend spec rather than a documented public developer API. missing for 10: first-party documentation advertising or explaining the spec, a public developer program or API keys to actually use the described endpoints, and independent corroboration beyond probes.
